analyze.context_builder.label: Context Builder
analyze.context_builder.description: Prepares intake metadata and transcript snippets used by downstream prompts.

analyze.extract_outline.label: Outline Extractor
analyze.extract_outline.description: Derives parties, issues, claims, facts, and legal references as structured JSON.

analyze.build_timeline_seeds.label: Timeline Seeder
analyze.build_timeline_seeds.description: Creates candidate timestamped events that can seed the timeline generator.

analyze.build_entity_hints.label: Entity Mapper
analyze.build_entity_hints.description: Identifies entities and proto-relationships to accelerate graph extraction.

analyze.draft_markdown.label: Analysis Drafter
analyze.draft_markdown.description: Produces the layered Markdown case analysis referencing transcript timestamps.

analyze.qa_and_finalize.label: QA & Finalize
analyze.qa_and_finalize.description: Validates mandatory sections, computes checksums, and prepares ops metadata.

compose.context_builder.label: Context Builder
compose.context_builder.description: Condenses intake metadata and approved analyses into a case brief for downstream stages.

compose.timeline_builder.label: Timeline Builder
compose.timeline_builder.description: Generates normalized timeline events with timestamp references using analysis seeds and transcript context.

compose.timeline_summary.label: Timeline Narrative
compose.timeline_summary.description: Summarizes the normalized timeline into a narrative section with key timestamps and parties.

compose.graph_builder.label: Graph Builder
compose.graph_builder.description: Extracts entities and relationships with evidence links, grounding against analysis hints and timelines.

compose.entity_brief.label: Entity Briefing
compose.entity_brief.description: Produces a concise briefing of principal entities, roles, and relationship highlights.

compose.graph_visual.label: Graph Visual Planner
compose.graph_visual.description: Plans embeddable graph visuals with sizing guidance and accessibility copy.

compose.client_brief.label: Client Brief Drafter
compose.client_brief.description: Drafts client-facing deliverables at a grade-six reading level with timeline references.

compose.lawyer_brief.label: Lawyer Brief Drafter
compose.lawyer_brief.description: Drafts professional deliverables for counsel, organized by legal issues and evidence.

compose.qa_review.label: QA Reviewer
compose.qa_review.description: Performs compliance checks on compose outputs and records discrepancies for ops logs.

guardian.review.label: Output Guardian
guardian.review.description: Final policy and safety review to block legal advice, interpretation, or form selection.
